direction: Signal Desk — cool slate paper, deep teal signal, IBM Plex + Vazirmatn (self-hosted)
assumptions: Full redesign (not audit-only) for all User + Admin pages
Avoid purple gradients, cream+terracotta, pill-everything, multi-shadow

categoryNotes.visualHierarchy: Brand mark + page title + status chip; jobs reason as dedicated callout
categoryNotes.typography: Vazirmatn Variable + IBM Plex Sans/Mono — no Inter/Roboto/system-only
categoryNotes.colorContrast: Teal on soft teal / ink on paper targets AA; dark scheme paired
categoryNotes.spacingLayout: Tokenized --space-* scale; filter rail separated from export actions
categoryNotes.navigationIa: User top nav; Admin dark signal rail with active border
categoryNotes.responsive: Shell collapses; job cards auto-fit meta grid
categoryNotes.accessibility: aria labels, role=alert/status, LTR latin fields, keyboard focus
categoryNotes.motion: 140ms nav/tab transitions only — no decorative motion noise
categoryNotes.aiSlopRemediation: Removed pill tabs/badges; no purple hero; flat elevation-1 only
